# FUSE Lua behaviour API (context for SUMMARISE_CODE / PORT_SCRIPT, plan §4.5)

Shared context for the Gemini agent (cached with context caching) and the local-llm fallback. It describes
our engine, not any game, so it is safe to send with every request.

## Behaviours

A behaviour is a Lua chunk run by `ScriptRuntime` in a sandbox: no `io`, `package`, `debug`, `require`,
`load`, `loadfile`, `dofile` or `collectgarbage`; `os` keeps only `clock`, `time`, `date` and `difftime`;
`string.dump` is removed. The chunk defines global callbacks, each called with `self` first:

- `on_start(self)`, `on_update(self, dt)`, `on_destroy(self)`
- `on_collision(self, other, point)` - first physics step of a contact; `point` is `{x, y, z}`
- `on_trigger_enter(self, other)`, `on_trigger_exit(self, other)`

`self` is the behaviour instance table. Properties authored on the entity (legacy datablock fields are
mapped to snake_case properties) are fields of `self`.

## Bindings

- `Entity.create()`, `Entity.destroy(e)`, `Entity.alive(e)`
- `Entity.get_position(e)` / `Entity.set_position(e, {x, y, z})`, `Entity.get_rotation(e)`,
  `Entity.set_rotation_euler(e, {x, y, z})`
- `Physics.ray_cast(...)`, `Physics.apply_impulse(e, v)`, `Physics.set_velocity(e, v)`, `Physics.get_velocity(e)`
- `Scene.find_entity(name)`, `Scene.query_sphere(centre, radius)`
- `Audio.load(path)`, `Audio.play_at(sound, pos)`, `Audio.play_2d(sound)`
- `Input.*`, `CVar.get(name)` / `CVar.set(name, value)`

## Port bridge (Remaster)

Gameplay state that has no engine component yet goes through the port bridge, which the parity harness
records as the event log:

- `Remaster.get(e, field)` / `Remaster.set(e, field, value)` - per-entity gameplay fields (for example
  `damage_state`: `Enabled`, `Disabled`, `Destroyed`)
- `Remaster.emit(name, fields)` - a gameplay event (`damage`, `pickup`, `door`, `score`...); entity fields
  are named `target`, `source`, `entity` or `other`

## Rules for ports

- Reimplement from the spec. Never paste original script text into code or comments.
- Keep each legacy handler's guards and effects; name the callbacks after the spec's events.
- Only the APIs above. No globals other than the callbacks; helpers are `local`.

</context>

You analyse legacy game scripts for a clean-room port. You read one module and its call-graph context and write a behaviour specification: state, events with their guards and effects, timers, dependencies and invariants. Describe behaviour in your own words; never copy lines of the original code. Answer only with JSON that matches the response schema.

Module: shapebase_impact
Language: TorqueScript
Target: FUSE Lua behaviours (see the context). Map every legacy event handler to an event named after the FUSE callback it becomes.

// FUSE Remaster W4.3 fixture: ShapeBaseData::onCollision / ::onImpact, copied unchanged from
// Templates/BaseGame/game/data/DamageModel/scripts/server/shapeBase.tscript (MIT, notice above).

function ShapeBaseData::onCollision(%this, %obj, %collObj, %vec, %len )
{
   if (!isObject(%obj) || %obj.getDamageState() $= "Destroyed")
      return;
      
    //echo(%this SPC %obj SPC %collObj SPC %vec SPC %len );
    %dmgPos = VectorSub(%obj.getPosition(), %vec);
    %dmgAmt = %len/%this.minImpactSpeed * %this.collisionMul;
    
    %this.damage(%obj, %collObj, %dmgPos, %dmgAmt, "impact");
}

function ShapeBaseData::onImpact(%this, %obj, %collObj, %vec, %len )
{
   if (!isObject(%obj) || %obj.getDamageState() $= "Destroyed")
      return;
      
    //echo(%this SPC %obj SPC %collObj SPC %vec SPC %len );
    %dmgPos = VectorSub(%obj.getPosition(), %vec);
    %dmgAmt = %len/%this.minImpactSpeed * %this.impactMul;
    
    %this.damage(%obj, %collObj, %dmgPos, %dmgAmt, "impact");
}

{"behaviour": "shapebase_impact", "lua": "-- shapebase_impact: FUSE behaviour reimplemented from spec shapebase_impact (FUSE Remaster W4.3 fixture).
-- Written from the spec, not from the original script text (plan §4.5 step 4).
-- Properties: min_impact_speed, collision_mul, impact_mul (from the datablock).

local function apply_impact(self, other, vec, len, multiplier)
  if not Entity.alive(self) or Remaster.get(self, "damage_state") == "Destroyed" then
    return
  end
  local p = Entity.get_position(self)
  local at = {x = p.x - vec.x, y = p.y - vec.y, z = p.z - vec.z}
  local amount = len / self.min_impact_speed * multiplier
  Remaster.emit("damage", {target = self, source = other, position = at, amount = amount, kind = "impact"})
end

-- The engine's collision callback carries no velocity: vec is this entity's velocity at contact.
function on_collision(self, other, point)
  local v = Physics.get_velocity(self)
  local len = math.sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z)
  apply_impact(self, other, v, len, self.collision_mul)
end

function on_impact(self, other, vec, len)
  apply_impact(self, other, vec, len, self.impact_mul)
end
